tools.name: myphoner_list_lists
tools.description: All calling lists (campaigns) in the account: id, name, creation date, number of leads and whether the list guarantees the default fields. Start here to find a list id. GET /lists.

tools.name: myphoner_get_list
tools.description: One calling list with its lead count and its call back / winner / loser / archive / skip categories. GET /lists/{id}.

tools.name: myphoner_list_columns
tools.description: The fields (columns) of a list. The `key` of each is the name to use when creating, updating or finding leads. GET /lists/{id}/columns.

tools.name: myphoner_get_list_stats
tools.description: Lead counts of a list by state (new, call back, won, lost, archived) and by category within each state. Use it for campaign progress and conversion questions. GET /lists/{id}/stats.

tools.name: myphoner_create_list
tools.description: Create a new, empty calling list with its fields. Creates data in the account (nothing is sent to anyone). Field kinds: none (text), phone, email, url, boolean, integer, date, text (multi-line), options, address. POST /lists.

tools.name: myphoner_list_leads
tools.description: Leads of one list, newest first by creation date (or most recently updated first with order=last_updated_first). Each lead has its state (new, call_back, won, lost, archived), category, scheduled call back, who claimed it and its lead_data fields. GET /lists/{id}/leads.

tools.name: myphoner_get_lead
tools.description: One lead with its state, category, claim, duplicates and all lead_data fields. GET /leads/{id}.

tools.name: myphoner_find_leads
tools.description: Exact match on one or more fields of a list, for example a phone number or an email address (to check whether a lead already exists). All fields must match unless match_all is false. GET /lists/{id}/leads/find.

tools.name: myphoner_search_leads
tools.description: Free-text search across lead data and activity logs (comments, events), like the search box in myPhoner; optionally limited to some lists. Returns the total hit count and one page of leads. GET /leads/search.

tools.name: myphoner_create_lead
tools.description: Add a new lead to a list. Keys of `fields` are the list's column keys (myphoner_list_columns). Creates data only; nothing is sent to the lead. Duplicate detection runs in the background a few minutes later (check detected_duplicates on the lead afterwards). POST /lists/{id}/leads.

tools.name: myphoner_update_lead
tools.description: Change field values of an existing lead (only the fields you pass change). Keys of `fields` are the list's column keys (myphoner_list_columns). Overwrites the old values; use null to clear one. PATCH /leads/{id}.

tools.name: myphoner_mark_lead_winner
tools.description: Mark a lead as a winner (a won deal). The lead moves to that state and an event is logged on it; nothing is sent to the lead. Optionally add a comment and an existing winner category. POST /leads/{id}/winner.

tools.name: myphoner_mark_lead_loser
tools.description: Mark a lead as a loser (not interested / lost). The lead moves to that state and an event is logged on it; nothing is sent to the lead. Optionally add a comment and an existing loser category. POST /leads/{id}/loser.

tools.name: myphoner_mark_lead_call_back
tools.description: Schedule a lead for a call back. The lead moves to that state and an event is logged on it; nothing is sent to the lead. Set when with call_back_in (minutes) or scheduled_for; optionally a comment and an existing call back category. POST /leads/{id}/call_back.

tools.name: myphoner_archive_lead
tools.description: Archive a lead (it leaves the calling queue). The lead moves to that state and an event is logged on it; nothing is sent to the lead. Optionally add a comment and an existing archive category. POST /leads/{id}/archive.

tools.name: myphoner_delegate_lead
tools.description: Give the claim on a lead to a user (the lead then shows up in that agent's queue), identified by user id or email. PATCH /leads/{id}/delegate.

tools.name: myphoner_move_lead
tools.description: Move a lead to another list. The destination may be the lead's current list, which with release_claim=true just releases a claimed lead. PATCH /leads/{id}/migrate.

tools.name: myphoner_get_call
tools.description: One call made from myPhoner: who called, the number dialed, duration (0 = unanswered), direction, disposition (normal, voicemail, no_answer, busy ...), state, the lead and list it belongs to, and recording links. GET /calls/{id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: myphoner_create_list, myphoner_find_leads, myphoner_search_leads, myphoner_create_lead · Public sink: myphoner_create_list, myphoner_find_leads, myphoner_create_lead, myphoner_mark_lead_winner, myphoner_mark_lead_loser, myphoner_mark_lead_call_back, myphoner_archive_lead, myphoner_delegate_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: myphoner_create_list, myphoner_find_leads, myphoner_search_leads, myphoner_create_lead · Public sink: myphoner_create_list, myphoner_find_leads, myphoner_create_lead, myphoner_mark_lead_winner, myphoner_mark_lead_loser, myphoner_mark_lead_call_back, myphoner_archive_lead, myphoner_delegate_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
